messages:
maria: Quick FYI — ran the weekly least-priv audit for Q3, rolling up results. Key numbers: 42 principals flagged with admin-ish roles, 12 temporary elevations >90d, 7 KMS grants with cross-project scopes. Filing a few tickets.
raj: thx — can you paste the CLI table output? :eyes:
maria: here’s the trimmed output i used for the rollup:
```
PRINCIPAL              ROLE           AGE_DAYS   KMS_SCOPES
svc-ingest-2021        editor         420        projects/*/kms/*
john@redwood           admin          120        -
svc-legacy-sync        writer         980        projects/payments/kms/key1
```
emma: who owns svc-ingest-2021? not seeing an owner in last-owner report.
maria: no owner tag; it's flagged as orphan. created ticket INF-2347 and marked P2.
dave: suggestion — deprovision svc-ingest-2021 in staging ASAP, hold prod until owner claim or we rotate keys.
IncidentBot: IncidentBot: ticket INF-2347 created by maria — priority P2
raj: KMS grants are the riskiest part. svc-legacy-sync should be scoped to payments KMS only; current wildcard scope is unacceptable. remediation: create a scoped key, rotate usage, and remove wildcard grant.
emma: compliance needs evidence for the audit by EOD Thu — export of access logs + short justification notes for each elevated principal.
maria: quick grep from audit logs i pulled:
```
2024-07-15T18:22:11Z svc-ingest-2021 accessed kms.projects/*/cryptoKeyVersions/1
2024-08-02T09:02:03Z svc-legacy-sync accessed projects/payments/kms/key1
```
raj: plan of action: 1) staging deprovision svc-ingest-2021 today; 2) provision scoped key + rotate svc-legacy-sync this week; 3) run /owners workflow and collect attestations; 4) upload manifest to audit bucket. assign: raj + maria.
dave: +1. i'll run a canary rotate at 10:00 tomorrow and watch the dashboards.
emma: looping in legal for retention requirements — @shelly-legal can you confirm retention for owner attestations for payment keys? :pray:
shelly-legal: Shelly: retention is 7 years for payment-related keys and 3 years for infra-only keys. we need signed attestations stored in encrypted audit storage.
maria: noted — creating audit manifest and uploading to gs://redwood-audit/privs/1748391234.json, will attach attestations as PDFs.
raj: thanks. i'll update the remediation tracker and set INF-2347 to in-progress. ping here when the rotate + attestations are in place; we'll close after validation.
